demo.program:
# PowerShell — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created PowerShell?", "Microsoft (Jeffrey Snover)"),
    ("What paradigm is PowerShell?", "object shell"),
    ("What is creator?", "Microsoft (Jeffrey Snover)"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "2006"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "object shell"),
    ("What is typing?", "dynamic"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".ps1"),
    ("What is hello world?", "Write-Host \"Hello, world!\""),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
